tools.name: prepare_quote
tools.description: Prepare an on-chain BlazePhoenix quote to run on YOUR OWN RPC. Returns the exact eth_call (Quoter address + calldata, as a ready JSON-RPC request and a curl line) plus a `request` object. Run the call on your node, then pass `request` and the result hex to decode_quote. This server performs no RPC.

chain.description: base | eth | optimism | arbitrum | robinhood (or a chain id)

in.description: input token — 0x address, or ETH / WETH / USDC

out.description: output token — 0x address, or ETH / WETH / USDC

amountIn.description: input amount in base units (wei-style integer string)

recipient.description: optional 0x address; with it (and userMinOut), decode_quote returns unsigned calldata that clears the swap math; simulate it as an eth_call to the Router from the payer before sending

slippageBps.description: 0–5000 (default 50); the calldata minimum is never under the quoted net output less this (exact mode: how far under it userMinOut may sit)

userMinOut.description: minimum output, base units, from a price you trust; required for calldata, which enforces the higher of it and the quoted net output less slippageBps (exact mode: exactly this value)

exact.description: true → previewPlanExact: every leg dry-run on its pool in this block; with recipient + userMinOut also calldata (exact mode applies a safety margin: userMinOut at or under exactOut less 50 bps). No tokens move from a holder, so a token that blocks or taxes its own transfer still quotes; simulate the swap from the holder to test that

usd.description: true → also `usd.in`: the eth_call valuing amountIn in USD (via USDC; USDG on Robinhood Chain), to decode with decode_usd_value; decode_quote then returns `usdOut`, the call valuing the output

blockHash.description: with usd: the hash of the block to pin usd.in at ({blockHash, requireCanonical: true}); read it with eth_getBlockByNumber and pass it to decode_usd_value too

tools.name: decode_quote
tools.description: Decode the eth_call result YOUR node returned for a prepare_quote call: net output after the 0.28% fee, price impact, the Phoenix Check verdict (ok / caution / danger / blocked — fails closed) and, in preview mode, the on-chain floor the Quoter reports for the route (ironFloor, effectiveMinOut). With a recipient and a userMinOut, it also returns unsigned calldata verified against the request, whose minimum output is the higher of your userMinOut and the quoted net output less slippageBps, never under the on-chain floor (exact mode: exactly your userMinOut; a recipient without a usable userMinOut returns a txError instead). The calldata clears the swap math, not the token transfer: before sending, simulate it as an eth_call to the Router from the paying address. Pure computation: it cannot authenticate your node's answer.

result.description: the 0x hex result of the eth_call on your node

tools.name: decode_usd_value
tools.description: Decode the eth_call result YOUR node returned for a USD value (`usd.in` of prepare_quote with usd:true, or `usdOut` of decode_quote): the amount in USD (via USDC; USDG on Robinhood Chain; the dollar token counts as 1 USD), measured as Quoter netOut after the 0.28% fee, including price impact. Each via (direct, via WETH, via the tokens the direct route crosses; at most 8) is listed; the value is the minimum over measured vias, with the spread when two or more are measured. A via that reverts, finds no route or nets 0 is "not measured"; with none measured the value is "not measured", never 0. When the route crosses other tokens, the answer is `next`: a second eth_call pinned at the block hash of the first (EIP-1898, requireCanonical); run it and decode that one. That needs blockHash, the hash of the block the first call ran at (read the header with eth_getBlockByNumber and pin the call there, or pass blockHash to prepare_quote, which pins usd.in only). usdOut of decode_quote is prepared at latest: replace latest with {blockHash, requireCanonical: true} of a header you read, run it, and pass that hash here as blockHash. Without a hash the value is "not measured", never a call pinned by number. If your node answers an error for the hash, start again. Pure computation.

request.description: the `request` object of the USD call (usd.in, usdOut or next), verbatim

result.description: the 0x hex result of that eth_call on your node

blockHash.description: the hash of the block the first USD call ran at (optional; needed when the route crosses other tokens)

tools.name: get_deployments
tools.description: The versioned BlazePhoenix deployment registry: Core, Hub, Solver, Quoter and Router addresses per chain and protocol version, each version with its status, and the version each chain resolves to as latest (`active`: the newest non-deprecated version deployed on that chain).

tools.name: get_abi
tools.description: The JSON ABI of one BlazePhoenix contract, generated from the Solidity sources, with the source revision it was built from. Use it to encode your own calls to the addresses get_deployments returns, or pass `errors` to decode a revert reason from a failed swap or quote. Returns { contract, revision, abi }; an unknown name returns ok:false with the accepted list. Pure lookup, no RPC.

contract.description: quoter (quotes and previews) | router (swap entry point) | solver | hub | core | errors (the protocol custom-error set, for decoding reverts)
